Complete your details at the top of the risk register sheet.

<!-- @exhibitor-risk-assessment.each-row-is-one -->
Each row is one hazard, not one item. Work left to right: what could go wrong, who it could harm, what you already do, what you will add for this event.

<!-- @exhibitor-risk-assessment.add-rows-for-anything -->
Add rows for anything unusual: games, interactive experiences, food or drink, machines or moving parts.

<!-- @exhibitor-risk-assessment.score-likelihood-and-severity -->
Score likelihood and severity before and after your controls. The score, the band and what to do about it work themselves out.

<!-- @exhibitor-risk-assessment.check-it-before-you -->
Check it before you submit, and update it if your plans change. Send it to {email} by the deadline in your contract.

<!-- @exhibitor-risk-assessment.likelihood-1-rare-2 -->
Likelihood 1 Rare, 2 Unlikely, 3 Possible, 4 Likely, 5 Almost certain. Severity 1 Minor injury or inconvenience, 2 First aid required, 3 Injury requiring medical treatment, 4 Serious injury, 5 Major injury or fatality. Score is likelihood times severity: Low 1 to 4, Medium 5 to 9, High 10 to 15, Critical 16 to 25.
